Qt Third-Party Software Notices
===============================

This release bundles Qt libraries and plugins through Qt for Python/PySide6.
Qt libraries and plugins may include third-party code that is licensed by
its original authors under separate open-source license terms.

Bundled Qt version: 6.11.1

Qt modules bundled in the current macOS standalone build include:
- QtCore
- QtDBus
- QtGui
- QtOpenGL
- QtOpenGLWidgets
- QtSvg
- QtWidgets

Only the licenses of third-party Qt components actually shipped with MyWB
apply to this release.

MyWB's Qt-related third-party component index is included at:
third_party/qt/QT-SHIPPED-THIRD-PARTY-COMPONENTS.txt

Full Qt third-party notices for Qt 6.11 are published by The Qt Company at:
https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/licenses-used-in-qt.html
